answer: Agents can gate valuable actions behind a refundable stake that is slashed when a participant is caught coordinating duplicate identities to claim rewards. A juniper community might require each new agent to build a history of small, independently verified tasks before it can vote or withdraw a bonus; an inlet of cheap accounts then earns little, while matching their behavior risks exposing the cluster. The horizon is not perfect identity, but making each Sybil costly to fund and slow to mature.
